_note: Active shopping rules. The runtime must OBEY these, not merely be able to read them. Rule 34 mandates trolley reconciliation; rule 40 mandates the Favourites/Regulars Brand A-Z pass; rule 33 maps Fruit Splits to ice lollies.

rows.rule_text: Milk means Cravendale Arla; never a Best-of-Both / BOB variant (short shelf life).
Toffees with no qualifier means ASDA Dairy Toffee 180g; mixed/assorted only if explicitly stated.
Nescafe means Azera only; add only if on offer, otherwise flag the full price and do not add.
Sure deodorant: male = blue variant, female = white variant.
Tomato sauce means Heinz Tomato Ketchup 910g.
Toothpaste means Aquafresh, cheapest size available (100ml does not exist; 75ml is the standard size).
Picnic Bars means Cadbury Picnic Chocolate Bar 4 Pack Multipack.
Yazoo: NEVER buy Banana (hard rule, Warwick 2026-07-18; disliked). Exclude on sight; Chocolate/Strawberry are the accepted flavours.
Frank's 6-pint means 1x ASDA British Milk Semi Skimmed 6 Pints (one pack), not 6 packs.
Vanish Pink = Oxi Action Stain Remover Powder (no Whitener wording, pink tub); Vanish White = Oxi Action Whitener & Stain Remover Powder (Whiter Whites badge).
Richmond sausages: pick the closest single Regulars match, e.g. Richmond 12 Skinless Pork Sausages 319g.
Hay fever tablets means an antihistamine (loratadine), e.g. ASDA Allergy & Hayfever Relief 10mg Loratadine 30 Tablets.
Sure deodorant male trigger: map "Sure male" to the blue variant. Companion directive row for parent rule 13 (Sure: male=blue, female=white).
Sure deodorant female trigger: map "Sure female" to the white variant. Companion directive row for parent rule 13 (Sure: male=blue, female=white).
Nescafe generic-phrasing trigger: flag for a human because Azera is added only if on offer and the plan cannot know offer state. Companion alias row for parent rule 12.
Yazoo Banana alias: NEVER buy (hard rule, Warwick 2026-07-18). Exclude on sight. Companion alias of rule 17.
Mum's "Sausage Baps" = Rustlers All Day Breakfast Sausage Muffin (Warwick 2026-07-21).
ASDA DISCONTINUED the combined custard & jelly pots (was a limited-time offer). Mum keeps listing them - do NOT add; note as discontinued. Supersedes rule 21 (Warwick 2026-07-21).
Mum's "Wall's sausage rolls (1 pack)" = the 4-pack (Warwick 2026-07-21).
Mum's "Soooo perfume" = So...? body mist; 2026-07 scent chosen = Honey Oud (Warwick).
Mum's "Fruit Splits" = fruit-flavour ICE LOLLIES (NOT the BEAR dried-fruit snack). If unavailable, use Just Essentials by ASDA Fruit Flavour Lollies 8x35ml (Warwick 2026-07-21).

MANDATORY FINAL STEP before handover: reconcile the built trolley against the ORIGINAL list — confirm every item is present, the correct product, and the correct QUANTITY. Agents repeatedly get QUANTITIES wrong (happened this week and last). Do this line-by-line check and fix before telling Warwick the basket is ready. (Warwick 2026-07-21)

2ND-TO-LAST STEP: on View Trolley, the "Allow substitutions for all" checkbox must ALWAYS be left UNTICKED. Set substitutions PER-ITEM from each product's substitutes_allowed flag (Warwick 2026-07-21).

Sure "any 2 for £X": round qty UP to an even number to capture every pair; add a FEMALE variant to complete the last pair (Mum 3 male -> add 1 female = 4). Combines with the rotate-variant rule (Warwick 2026-07-21).

REAL cause of "add to trolley" failing = the item is OUT OF STOCK, NOT an expired slot. OOS items still appear in Favourites/Regulars but silently reject the add (Lucozade Orange 4x500 was OOS tonight). If an add fails -> item likely OOS: drop it or use an approved alternative (Warwick 2026-07-21).
Mum "3 Mince Hotpot" = ASDA hotpot ready meals: 2 beef + 1 chicken (Warwick 2026-07-21). NOT in regulars - missed this week because it needs a search and the agent silently dropped it.

ADD STRATEGY: DEFAULT = FULL pass. Sort Regulars by BRAND A-Z, tick every matching item, and bulk "Add selected to trolley" in ONE go. Two-at-a-time is ONLY the FALLBACK: if the bulk add errors, an item in the batch is almost certainly OUT OF STOCK (that was the real cause tonight, NOT batch size - the OOS Lucozade Orange kept being included). Then split the batch only to isolate + drop the OOS item, and resume the full pass. Do NOT scroll-hunt or switch views mid-pass. (Warwick 2026-07-21)

Sure deodorant male: ALWAYS take Sure Nonstop Protection Quantum Dry Anti-Perspirant Aerosol 250 ml (regular 25). FIXED CHOICE - do NOT rotate, do NOT offer variants, do NOT ask. Warwick, 2026-08-17, verbatim: "Ffs sick to death of the sure debate. I don't care! Pick one, make rule always this type of sure and not the other". SUPERSEDES rule 32 (rotate weekly), now inactive - rotation was unenforceable anyway because order lines only ever recorded "Sure male" and never the variant. Quantum Dry chosen because it is the only male variant carrying a real asda_product_id, so it adds reliably from Favourites. Female variant (regular 21) remains valid only when the list explicitly says female.
